🔒 Privacy-first

Neither your API key nor your activity data ever leaves your device.

🔒

Your API key is encrypted with AES-256-GCM

Stored locally, encrypted. Never kept as plain text

💻

All data stays on your device

Never sends data to any external server other than Backlog

🚫

No Tracking

No analytics, advertising, or tracking services

📦

Never executes remote code

All code is bundled in the package and reviewed by the Store

A tool you can trust and use every day.

Both your personal information and your work data stay strictly between you and Backlog.

Backlog My Tasks

A Chrome extension that lets you check and manage your assigned Backlog tasks across multiple spaces in one place. 8 views and a project dashboard make daily task management and team progress tracking easier.

Display Views
  • 8 views
  • Home View
  • Bulk Entry & Update Sheet
  • Matrix
  • Kanban
  • Gantt
  • Calendar
  • Burndown / Workload
